sword.role: Balanced speed, reach, damage, and recovery.

dagger.role: Fast, close-range pressure with strong aerial chaining.

spear.role: Long, narrow thrusts and deliberate anti-air control.

heavy.role: Slow, committed strikes with high damage and stagger.

bow.role: Ranged charge attacks powered by regenerating energy.

staff.role: Energy projectiles, charged casts, and area control.

sword_phase_edge.description: Balanced phase-forged blade with reliable ground and air control.
sword_phase_edge.lore: Standard relay-warden steel, tuned to hold an edge across short phase jumps.

dagger_signal_pair.description: Fast paired blades for close pressure and aerial chaining.
dagger_signal_pair.lore: Twin signal knives recovered from the Rooftop Alley safehouse network.

spear_arc_lance.description: Long, narrow thrusts with deliberate anti-air reach.
spear_arc_lance.lore: A skybridge maintenance lance rebuilt around a phase-current conductor.

heavy_foundry_maul.description: Slow committed strikes with exceptional damage and stagger.
heavy_foundry_maul.lore: A factory breaker head rebalanced into a two-handed kinetic weapon.

bow_voltage_arc.description: Precise ranged pressure and a high-velocity charged technique.
bow_voltage_arc.lore: Billboard capacitors feed its limbs with reclaimed city current.

staff_lumen_rod.description: Energy projectiles, charged casts, and broad area control.
staff_lumen_rod.lore: A relay calibration rod adapted to focus unstable phase light.

staff_coolant_coil.description: A factory-tuned staff frame using the complete Lumen Rod move set.
staff_coolant_coil.lore: Smelting coolant loops keep its focus crystal stable under repeated casts.

dagger_servo_pair.description: Maintenance-grade paired cutters using the Signal Pair move set.
dagger_servo_pair.lore: Matched robotic servos preserve their timing even inside gravity faults.

bow_lunar_prism.description: A lunar bow frame using the complete Voltage Arc move set.
bow_lunar_prism.lore: Cleanroom prism limbs bend neon-moon light into a coherent firing line.

spear_orbit_lance.description: An orbital spear frame using the complete Arc Lance move set.
spear_orbit_lance.lore: Its counterweight was built for low gravity and remains stable planetside.

staff_oracle_focus.description: An Oracle-calibrated staff using the complete Lumen Rod move set.
staff_oracle_focus.lore: The focus cage contains a harmless echo of the lunar command intelligence.

bow_void_string.description: A corruption-resistant bow using the complete Voltage Arc move set.
bow_void_string.lore: Abyssal fibers hold tension without absorbing the surrounding field.

spear_cleansing_spike.description: A sanctuary spear using the complete Arc Lance move set.
spear_cleansing_spike.lore: Its tip carries the same phase pattern used by outpost cleansing arrays.

sword_convergence_edge.description: A final-region blade using the complete Phase Edge move set.
sword_convergence_edge.lore: Clean city alloy and abyssal crystal meet at a stable, impossible seam.
